      HOW TO EXPLORE

      Automatic or manual?

      Automatic

      Use the time and occupancy controls to simulate a change in conditions. After a change, the villa applies the room’s demo rules. No tap on the room display is needed.

      Manual

      Choose a living room scene, use the wall display, or adjust a bedroom or kitchen control. The next change to that room’s simulated conditions reapplies its automatic settings.

      Sensor tests

      In the kitchen, test a smoke or water leak alarm to see the effect in the room and the alert on the phone preview. The main entrance burglary test is in the bedroom.

      Private browser demo

      All automation rules and sensor readings are simulated. This demo has no real equipment, alarm, tracking, camera, or account connection.

      Tap the highlighted area or select Next.
